exposure: Number of vaginal examinations (VEs) performed during labor
Number of vaginal examinations (VEs) during labor
Number of VEs (up to 2, 3-4, 5-6, 7 or more)
cohort: 22,387 Women admitted to the delivery ward between 2008 and 2017 in active labor
finding: Performing five or more vaginal examinations during active labor was associated with an increased risk of severe perineal trauma.
